read: The board is range-bound under a mild risk-off BTC regime; the cleanest imbalances are swept 1d/4h lows on VVV and AAVE with funding at the neutral floor, and kPEPE is stretched on the upside.

watchlist.note: kPEPE is +11 vs BTC over 24h, 3.43 ATR over the 4h SMA20 with OI up 11.11% over 24h; funding matches CEX, so base case is a fade only after a sweep of the high.
watchlist.arms: a 4h sweep of the high with a close back under the 4h range high

watchlist.note: LIT trends down on 4h and 1d, is -21.05 vs BTC over 7d and HL funding is 49.74 points over CEX; the 4h just swept its low, so a short needs a bounce first. We lean continuation, low-confidence.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back under the 4h SMA20 after a bounce, with a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: WLD was stopped out and sits at 1d rangePos 0.08 after a 1d low sweep, -19.43 vs BTC over 7d; OI 24h is -0.5%, 0.5 short of the failed-breakout threshold.
watchlist.arms: OI 24h at or above 0 with the 1d sweep still in place

watchlist.note: XMR is in a 1w and 1d uptrend, 0.85 ATR from the 1d SMA20 against the 0.75 threshold, but 24h funding is 39.78% annualised, the reason last run's long was cancelled; risk skews to a crowded-long pullback.
watchlist.arms: mark within 0.75 ATR of the 1d SMA20 with 24h funding back near neutral

passes.reason: relative weakness of -21.05 vs BTC over 7d and a 1d downtrend; the sweep is a continuation, not a reclaim, and no 2R level is within reach
at most 2 new per run; 1d volRatio 0.32 shows a thin sweep and the 1d ATR ratio is compressed at 0.64
already open as DOGE-short-20261028-1 and triggered; one open per market and direction

brief: Delta since the 18:56 run: no open setup closed; ZEC long, ENA short and DOGE short remain triggered. WLD long was stopped at -1R earlier today, and XMR long was cancelled last run when funding crowded. New this run: two low-conviction failed-breakout longs, VVV (4h sweep of the low) and AAVE (1d sweep of the low), both with funding at the neutral floor. Risk skews to a BTC break of the cost-basis levels, which would invalidate both; hl-cycles data is stale (17.6 h) and 7d OI changes are null.
